name: pin-it
description: Pin Claude replies to a side pane so they stay in view

keep.title: Pin it: keep pins
keep.description: How long saved pins are kept. "7 days" clears each pin a week after it was pinned; "forever" keeps pins until you unpin them.

sync.title: Pin it: sync pins
sync.description: How an open session picks up pins another session saved in the same project. "on activity" checks when you send a prompt, when Claude finishes, and when you open the pane with /pins; "every 5 seconds" also checks on a timer.
